answer: Beacon checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts a $10 deposit, then answers random beacon challenges with a live-compute heartbeat. One machine cannot carry a plume of fakes: 100 fakes need 100 machines. At $40 each monthly plus deposits, a 100-fake farm pays $5,000, more than its voyage of votes can divert. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards from the river of fees; missed checks forfeit its deposit.
